title: Gluten-Free Ciabatta Sandwich with Rich Cheese
description: A delicious and easy-to-make sandwich featuring rich cheese melted between two slices of gluten-free ciabatta. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Rich cheese (such as brie or camembert)

instructions: 1. Preheat a toaster or toaster oven to 350°F (180°C).
2. Place the slices of gluten-free ciabatta in the toaster or toaster oven and toast until lightly browned.
3. Remove the ciabatta from the toaster or toaster oven and spread a slice with the rich cheese.
4. Place the second slice of ciabatta on top of the cheese.
